links.outcome: Demographic accuracy of AI-generated patient images versus real-world epidemiology across 29 diseases
links.effect: Generated images failed to depict sex, age, and race/ethnicity accurately versus epidemiology; White and normal-weight individuals were over-represented.
links.quote: Comparison to the real-world epidemiology showed that the generated images failed to depict demographical characteristics such as sex, age, and race and ethnicity accurately.

screen.reason: Empirical study benchmarking demographic representation and biases of generative AI text-to-image models across health conditions without testing a specific organizational deployment practice.
